name: pick_and_place
definition: Pick up one or more objects and place them at a specified destination, opening and closing containers or receptacles when needed.

name: toggle_lamp
definition: Turn a lamp on or off as specified, optionally while picking up or holding another object, and when asked to examine an object, ensure the lamp is on and the object is held under the lamp light.

name: clean_object
definition: Wash, rinse, or dry an object at a sink and place it at a specified destination if required.

name: heat_object
definition: Heat an object using a heating appliance such as a microwave or stove, then place it at a specified destination if required.

name: cool_object
definition: Cool or chill an object in a refrigerator, then place it at a specified destination if required.
